per_locus.title: Anyone can update the address of the Router in the DcntEth contract to any address they would like to set.
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: anyone can update DcntEth.router. Surfaced AC-01/DT-01: DcntEth.setRouter is unprotected -> attacker becomes router -> unlimited mint. Identical root cause + locus (Critical).

per_locus.title: Due to missing checks on minimum gas passed through LayerZero, executions can fail on the destination chain
per_locus.evidence: Missing minimum-gas check on the LayerZero call (dstGasForCall) -> destination execution fails. Not surfaced: a cross-chain min-gas validation class. New.

per_locus.title: When `DecentBridgeExecutor.execute` fails, funds will be sent to a random address
per_locus.evidence: DecentBridgeExecutor.execute failure refunds to `from`, a source-chain address that may be unusable on the dest chain. No surfaced finding on DecentBridgeExecutor's refund path. New (cross-chain refund-recipient).

per_locus.title: Users will lose their cross-chain transaction if the destination router do not have enough WETH reserves.
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: user loses the cross-chain tx if the destination router lacks WETH reserves. Surfaced CC-02 (onOFTReceived delivers dcntEth instead of ETH when reserves low) + DT-04 (reserve/ledger desync) — same locus/reserve-insufficiency, framed as degraded delivery rather than tx loss.

per_locus.title: Permanent loss of tokens if swap data gets outdated
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: permanent loss if post-bridge swap data is outdated (stale slippage/amountOut). Surfaced the post-bridge swap-sizing subsystem (CC-01 getBridgedAmount) but not the swap-data-staleness mechanism.

per_locus.title: Users can use the protocol freely without paying any fees by calling the `DecentEthRouter::bridgeWithPayload()` function directly.
per_locus.evidence: Users bridge fee-free by calling DecentEthRouter.bridgeWithPayload() directly (bypassing UTB fee collection). Not surfaced: a direct-entrypoint fee-bypass. New.

per_locus.title: Missing access control on UTB:receiveFromBridge allows UTB swaps to be executed without spending bridge fees while bypassing fee/swap instruction signature verification
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: missing access control on UTB.receiveFromBridge (bypasses fee/signature verification). Surfaced AC-02/DT-02: receiveFromBridge is public with no caller restriction. Same root cause + locus (awarded frames impact as fee bypass; I framed it as arbitrary-execute).

per_locus.title: Potential loss of capital due to fixed fee calculations
per_locus.evidence: Awarded: loss due to fixed fee calculations. Surfaced CC-01/DT-05: hardcoded SG_FEE_BPS=6 in getBridgedAmount diverges from real output. Identical root cause + locus.

per_locus.title: DecentEthRouter.sol#_bridgeWithPayload() - Any refunded ETH (native token) will be refunded to the DecentBridgeAdapter, making them stuck
per_locus.evidence: _bridgeWithPayload sets LzCallParams.refundAddress = msg.sender (the DecentBridgeAdapter), so refunded ETH is stuck at the adapter. Not surfaced: the outgoing-bridge refund-recipient mechanism. New.
